name: Knowing the Holy Spirit
promise: Meet the Holy Spirit as a Person, then learn step by step to be filled, taught and led by him every day.
why: For believers who know about the Holy Spirit but want to walk with him. It starts with who he is and why Jesus sent him, shows how he lives in your spirit and fills you with power, then builds daily practice: praying in tongues, fellowship with him, his inner teaching and leading. Later teachings cover his gifts and anointing for serving others and how to honour rather than grieve him, and the series ends with walking in the Spirit day by day.

days.theme: A Person you can know, not a force
days.key_quote: That was when I knew that the Holy Ghost was a person, not because I saw it in scripture; I experienced him.

days.theme: From with you to in you
days.key_quote: The first blessing that the Holy Spirit makes available when he comes into your ecosystem is that he gives you the blessing of access.

days.theme: Joined to the Lord as one spirit
days.key_quote: When you gave your life to Christ, what God did is that he established the economy called one Spirit: your spirit and the Holy Spirit mingled together to form an economy.
That means if you ask him for the Holy Ghost, he will never deny you.
So speaking in tongues is an avenue to access spiritual rest and spiritual refreshing.

days.theme: A friendship you build on purpose
days.key_quote: God wants you to have a secret life with him.

days.theme: The anointing within that teaches you
days.key_quote: The anointing within is for your maturity; the anointing upon is for ministry.

days.theme: Telling his leading from your own noise
days.key_quote: The thoughts that come from your human Spirit, they are in line with the word of God; the thoughts that come from your soul, they are contradictory with the word of God.
God can manage you as an individual because he has the administration to do that and that's why he is not afraid of diversity.
The bottom line is this: you are therefore empowered to do good.

days.theme: Honour his lordship, guard his peace
days.key_quote: The snail is very sensitive. I need you to understand that the Holy Spirit is more sensitive than that snail.

days.theme: Learning to walk, step by step
days.key_quote: Just walk with God and everything that you need for life and for godliness will begin to navigate in your direction.
